text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our 1st Live is coming up soon. As I 
handed out flyers in front of the school 
gates with Light Hello and the others—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"An Umamusume has stepped forward to offer 
her help! A new companion has joined for 
the upcoming live!"
